statusLine.command: bash -c "input=\$(cat); model=\$(echo \"\$input\" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir=\$(echo \"\$input\" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=\$(git -C \"\$dir\" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); context=\$(echo \"\$input\" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); git_info=\"\"; [ -n \"\$branch\" ] && git_info=\" [\$branch]\"; context_info=\"\"; [ -n \"\$context\" ] && context_info=\" | Context: \$context%\"; printf \"%s%s | %s%s\" \"\$model\" \"\$git_info\" \"\$dir\" \"\$context_info\""
